tools.name: about_iverios
tools.description: Information about IVERIOS and IVERIOS Trust Center: what it is, how vendors publish a trust center and how customers (assessors) use it — access requests, NDA, questionnaires, AI assistants — plus pricing, FAQ and the other IVERIOS tools. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign in with your e-mail (OAuth) to see restricted information in trust centers where you are an approved visitor. Call this when the user asks for documents or details that are shared only with approved visitors. Returns who you are signed in as and your approved trust centers.

tools.name: list_trust_centers
tools.description: Lists IVERIOS trust centers you can query: those where you are an approved visitor (full access) and, with a query, public trust centers matching a company name or domain. Call this first to get the trust_center id for the other tools.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Summary of the company's security and compliance posture: certificates, regulations, number of security controls per area, privacy and data location, subprocessors, available documents, FAQ and security contact. Start here.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.description: Certifications (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2) with status, issuer, accreditation, issue/expiry dates, scope and the certificate document if available.

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: Implemented security controls with descriptions. Optional filter by area: governance, infrastructure, data, application, access, incident, continuity.

tools.name: get_infrastructure
tools.description: High-level infrastructure overview: components by layer (users, edge, application, data, backup, identity, monitoring, external) and type, provider/region, network zone, internet exposure, authentication, the security controls on each component, and the connections between components (e.g. "Web appl

tools.name: get_privacy
tools.description: Data processing description, data location, DPO contact and international data transfers (GDPR Chapter V: countries, transfer mechanisms, safeguards).

tools.name: list_subprocessors
tools.description: Subprocessors with purpose, location and transfer mechanism.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Published documents (policies, audit reports, certificates…) with category, validity and whether the text is accessible with the current access level. Use get_document_text to read one.

tools.name: get_document_text
tools.description: Plain text of an accessible document, in slices of up to 20000 characters. Use next_offset to continue.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search across the trust center content and accessible documents. Returns matching passages with their source. Use short keywords (e.g. "encryption at rest", "backup", "MFA"), not full sentences. Without trust_center, searches the trust centers where you are an approved visitor and those whos

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text of a search result by its id (a trust center section such as "sec:privacy" or a document "doc:<id>"), with title and source URL for citation. Ids look like "<trust_center>/sec:privacy" or "<trust_center>/doc:<id>".

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_certificates, fetch · Private data: sign_in, get_overview, list_certificates, get_infrastructure, get_privacy, list_documents, get_document_text, search, fetch · Public sink: about_iverios.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_certificates, fetch · Private data: sign_in, get_overview, list_certificates, get_infrastructure, get_privacy, list_documents, get_document_text, search, fetch · Public sink: about_iverios

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
